checks.check: every captured buffer reads back at its stated size with finite floats

CONTROL: a projection term off by 1 % fails the depth check
measured: pixels whose depth the opaque pass changed after the prepass copy

measured: drawn pixels whose normal points away from the viewer (cosine over 0.25)
checks.note: two-sided foliage keeps its front-face normal on back faces

checks.note: pixels outside are surfaces that moved on their own (wind, actors)
